_comment: Graphics presets for Ghostline. Medium is the default and the one that must hold 60 FPS on a MacBook Air M4. 'upscaler' = auto picks MetalFX Spatial on the Metal driver and FSR 1 elsewhere. 'max_render_height' caps the 3D resolution on high-density displays (the 15-inch Air is 1846 pixels tall): the effective scale is the smaller of render_scale and max_render_height / window height. Godot offers 1, 2 or 4 directional shadow cascades (no 3).

_auto_detect._comment: First launch runs 10 seconds on Medium. Below the low thresholds the game picks Low; at or above the high threshold it picks High (High costs about 2.4 times Medium on Apple Silicon, so it needs a large margin); otherwise Medium.
